column1: # *** WHAT THE VARIANT SWEEP TURNED UP, 15 September 2026 - part two. ***
# Searching the surname under LERENA and LORENA rather than only LLERENA, and then searching the
# PHRASE "[L]erena y de Maria Fernandez", returned five more Uruguayan documents this archive had
# never opened. *** One is a child nobody knew about. One names two enslaved people this family held.
# One gives a son's military rank and puts TRESGUERRAS on a second act. ***
*** 11 DECEMBER 1806 - A CHILD THIS ARCHIVE HAS NEVER HAD: JOSE LORETO ***
column2: Canelones, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-W9KR-W: *** "En el ano del Senor de mil ochocientos seis a once dias de Diciembre ... bautizo solemnemente a un parvulo de un dia de edad y puso por nombre JOSE LORETO, hijo legitimo de SANCHO LORENA y de MARIA FERNANDEZ vecinos de esta Villa, fue padrino Jose Martinez de la Vega vecino de Montevideo." ***
column4: *** Born 10 December 1806. He is in no tree, no padron and no previous record here. *** *** And he is NOT in the 1812 padron *** - which lists Juan Agustin 21, Pedro Antonio 19, Agustina 17, Fidel 12, Justa 10 and Dominga 7, but no boy of about five. *** So he most likely died between 1806 and 1812, which is what the silence of a household return usually means about a small child. *** *** He is the eighth child now attested, and the tree's own prose said there were eight while naming seven. ***

column1: *** 26 SEPTEMBER 1812 - AND THE ARCHIVE CAN NAME ONE OF THE PEOPLE THIS FAMILY HELD ***
column2: Montevideo, Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepcion, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9BW-X757-D: *** "En veinte y seis de Septiembre de mil ochocientos doce: Yo el infrascrito bautice solemnemente a MARIA MERCEDES, que nacio antes de ayer, NEGRA ESCLAVA DE DON SANCHO LERENA Y DE DONA MARIA FERNANDEZ, hija de JUANA. Madrina Catalina Martinez." ***
column4: *** The 1812 padron records four enslaved people in Sancho's household at calle San Juan No 60 and gives none of them a name. *** *** This act names two: JUANA, and her daughter MARIA MERCEDES, born 24 September 1812. *** *** They are people, and this archive will record them as people rather than as a number in a census line. *** The child was born in the same household and the same month that the padron was taken. *** Nothing here is known about what became of either of them. ***

column1: *** 22 MARCH 1826 - PEDRO ANTONIO IS A MAJOR, AND TRESGUERRAS IS ON A SECOND ACT ***
column2: Montevideo Catedral, ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-YSVD-2: *** "bautice solemnemente a FRANCISCO JUAN RAMON, que nacio en ocho de dicho mes, hijo legitimo del CAPITAN Don ANTONIO RODRIGUEZ DE CARBALLO y de Dona DOMINGA LLERENA ... y por parte de Madre, de Don SANCHO DE LLERENA y de Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ TESGUERZA. Fueron sus Padrinos el MAYOR DON PEDRO ANTONIO LLERENA y la Exma Senora Dona Rita Francisco de Paula Maquessi." ***
column4: *** THREE THINGS. *** *** (1) PEDRO ANTONIO holds military rank - 'el Mayor' - in 1826, at thirty-two. *** His father was a soldado dragon in 1793; the son is a major thirty-three years later. *** (2) "MARIA FERNANDEZ TESGUERZA" is TRESGUERRAS on an act for the second time *** - this archive had it once, from the 1830 marriage of Justa Pastora, and had called that a vindication of the trees. It is now twice. *** (3) "Don SANCHO DE LLERENA" - the toponymic DE form again. *** This archive had it once, in 1828, and built an argument on it about Extremadura against the Basque reading. Here it is two years earlier. *** A grandson's baptism gives the family a captain, a major, and its own surname in the form that argues about where it came from. ***
